project.name: jinfer-xcache
project.description: The x prompt cache (FloatTensor migration): the model-agnostic KV cache over the xboundary seam - hot sessions, content-keyed blocks with a RAM budget, and the JKVF catalog artifact that survives restarts. Models contribute only a StateCodec (xboundary); seeds are ContentKeys. Ported from jinfer-core/cache with the seed type unified on ContentKey and the modelSeed hashing law left to xchat Models.
